# Vinayak Bhardwaj: full profile

> Mechanical engineer based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Eight years on Malaysian job sites, from QA/QC on commercial builds to the Tun Razak Exchange and rope access on KL towers. Now builds AI agent workflows and websites (Virin Digital) and produces long-form documentaries (Vinayak Tech), applying the same inspection habits from site.

Canonical site: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/
Short index: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/llms.txt

## 1. What he does for businesses in Kuala Lumpur

### AI agent workflows and automation
He takes a manual process, such as lead intake, reporting or document checks, and maps it the way he mapped a non-conformance on site: where it fails, why, and who signs it off. He then builds agents that do the work and a second step that checks it. Delivered through Virin Digital (https://www.virindigital.com/).

### Websites
Hand-built sites for founders and service businesses: quick on a phone, readable by search engines and AI assistants, and wired to send every enquiry somewhere a person will see it. vinayakbhardwaj.com and virindigital.com are built this way.

### Documentary media
Vinayak Tech (https://www.youtube.com/@Vinayak_ai_tech) takes one claim about AI or money per episode, follows the documents and numbers behind it, and explains it in plain language. Scripts, research, motion graphics and sound are made in-house.

## 2. The method

On site, a defect gets a Non-Conformance Report (NCR). Nothing closes until someone has found the cause, fixed it and checked the fix. His AI workflows follow the same loop:

| On site (TRX, 2021–24) | In an AI workflow |
|---|---|
| Inspect against the drawing | Define what correct output looks like |
| Raise an NCR for anything out of tolerance | Agent does the work |
| Find the root cause | A checker tests the output against the definition |
| Correct it with the trade responsible | Fix and retry, or route to a person |
| Verify and close, signed, with a record | Log and sign off; every run is traceable |

## 3. Case studies

### Virin Digital (Founder, January 2024–present)
- Problem: small service businesses lose enquiries to slow sites and manual intake.
- Built: hand-built websites, and AI agent pipelines for research, content and enquiry triage, each with a checking step and a cost cap.
- Result: the studio's own site is live. Client case studies will be published as clients approve them.

### Vinayak Tech (Researcher and producer, 2024–present)
- Problem: stories about AI datacenters, power bills and pricing algorithms are usually told with opinions rather than documents.
- Built: a research process starting from primary sources, a code-driven motion graphics pipeline in Remotion, and audio mastered to -14 LUFS.
- Result: six long-form episodes published since September 2026, including "The $700 Billion AI Lie: The Datacenter Autopsy", "The Secret AI Tax Hidden On Your Electric Bill" and "The Algorithm That Secretly Raised Your Rent".

### Rotol Group, Menara Maybank and KLCC towers (Project operations and site supervisor, March 2024–present)
- Problem: façade maintenance and rope-access rigging at 50+ storeys in tropical wind.
- Ran: Safe Work Method Statements, pre-rig load checks, permit-to-work gates, an anemometer wind cutoff, and a rescue plan for every drop, under HIRARC and DOSH Malaysia requirements.
- Result: zero lost-time incidents over 12+ consecutive months, and formal sign-off from building managers on completed work.

### WCT, Tun Razak Exchange (Site engineer, structural QA/QC, 2021–2024)
- Problem: many contractor teams across civil, structural, architectural and MEP packages on Malaysia's 70-acre international financial district.
- Ran: inspection against drawings before concrete pours, NCRs traced to root cause, and handoffs between trades.
- Result: every NCR in his zones closed at root cause without recurring, with a complete audit trail for consultant sign-off.
